title: Require Public Domain Surfaces In Tests
forbids: test files deep-importing domain internals instead of public domain surfaces
why: Tests exercise domain contracts through the same named public surfaces as product code. Test location alone does not grant private implementation access.
remediate: Replace each violating test import with a public domain surface only after the corresponding domain public surface exists. Do not widen a domain public surface merely to satisfy a test.
message: Use the domain root, ops, artifacts, named model schema/policy modules, or a named model data collection instead of domain internals.
